verses.english: “Mendicants, the arising of perception of sights …

verses.pali: yo dhammasaññāya uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
verses.english: perception of ideas … is the manifestation of old age and death.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpasaññāya nirodho …pe…
verses.english: The cessation of perception of sights …

verses.pali: yo dhammasaññāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
verses.english: perception of ideas … is the disappearance of old age and death.”
